instrument: python3 time.perf_counter wall seconds on the lane host, plus operation counters

lean.axioms: every theorem within propext and Quot.sound; the coefficient controls use no axioms
lean.cold_compile: exit 0; all six repo Lean files compile cold

main.output: every field equal to the baseline port output

probe.output: every field equal to the baseline port output

small.output: every field equal to the persisted view, including full float components

field3.output: edges, full components, interaction matrices, liveness and mu equal on all 9 views; exact sensitivity equal to the recorded restricted-family sensitivity on all 9 views; dead lists newly evaluated
